changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE template_day_item ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, week_template_id BIGINT NOT NULL, day_template_id BIGINT NOT NULL, day_of_week INTEGER NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_day_item_dayofweek UNIQUE (week_template_id, day_of_week), CONSTRAINT fk_day_item_week_tpl FOREIGN KEY (week_template_id) REFERENCES week_template (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_day_item_day_tpl FOREIGN KEY (day_template_id) REFERENCES day_template (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE INDEX idx_day_item_week_tpl ON template_day_item (week_template_id); CREATE INDEX idx_day_item_day_tpl ON template_day_item (day_template_id);
